home.title: Thailand Business Training & Bank Verification Portal
home.description: Prepare for your company's bank account verification. Study your own DBD certificate, pass the Business Knowledge Quiz, and take the Bank Readiness Interview with a simulated bank officer.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.hint: Use the login ID and password from your administrator.
auth.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Please contact your administrator.

next.exam: Your next step is the Business Knowledge Quiz. Passing it unlocks the Bank Readiness Interview.
next.nameCard: Your next step is the name card. Create it before the Bank Readiness Interview.
next.interview: Your next step is the Bank Readiness Interview. The officer asks about your company, in Thai.

next.done: You have completed every step. Well done.

createDbd.title: Create DBD
createDbd.intro: Upload the company’s DBD documents and give the four details below. The documents are read and indexed in the background (1–3 minutes); when every fact is found, the company confirms itself and can be given to a learner.
createDbd.introNoReader: Upload the company’s DBD documents and give the four details below. Automatic reading is not set up here, so open the company afterwards to fill it in and confirm it.
createDbd.byHand: Enter a company by hand instead
createDbd.created: Uploaded. The documents are being read — the company is listed below and confirms itself when everything is found.
createDbd.createdNoReader: Uploaded. Open the company below to fill it in and confirm it.
createDbd.companiesIntro: Each learner studies one company's DBD record — its study material, questions and bank date. Only confirmed companies can be given to a learner.
createDbd.addCompany: Add a company that isn't listed
createDbd.addCompanyHint: Upload its DBD documents — it's checked automatically in 1–3 minutes.

loginIdField.label: Login ID
loginIdField.hint: One letter and two numbers, e.g. A12. A free code is filled in — keep it, press ↻ for another, or type your own.
loginIdField.taken: This login ID is already taken — choose another
loginIdField.invalid: Use one letter and two numbers, e.g. A12
loginIdField.noTeam: This team cannot take new learners
loginIdField.hintLearner: Two letters and two numbers, e.g. DA42. A free code is filled in — keep it, press ↻ for another, or type your own.
loginIdField.invalidLearner: Use two letters and two numbers, e.g. DA42
loginIdField.availableKeep: ✓ Available — keep it, press ↻ for another, or type your own

dbd.title: DBD records
dbd.dateHint: As printed on the certificate, e.g. 9 เมษายน 2569, 09/04/2569 or 9 April 2026
dbd.directorsHint: One director per line: Thai name | English name

errors.upload-failed: The file could not be uploaded (connection lost or not a PDF). Please try again.
errors.invalid-file: Only PDF files up to 30 MB are accepted (6 files at most)
errors.answers-required: Cannot save: this record is confirmed, so its contact and business answers must be complete first (see below).

dbd.extracted: Extraction complete — review the suggested values below, then save and confirm.
dbd.extractHint: Reads the uploaded certificate again and fills only fields that are still empty.
dbd.extractionNotConfigured: AI extraction is not configured (set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
dbd.reviewSuggestions: Suggested values from the certificate are shown where the record is still empty. Check every field — especially highlighted ones — then Save and Confirm.

extractErrors.provider: The extraction service failed. Try again later.
extractErrors.invalid_output: The extraction result was not usable.
extractErrors.too_large: The documents exceed 30 MB in total; split or compress them

dbd.uploadFirstHint: Choose the Thai PDFs (several at once: certificate, objectives sheet, Bor.Or.Jor.5, Bor.Or.Jor.2). The documents are read and all three levels are filled in automatically; you then review, correct if needed, and confirm.
dbd.uploadFirstNoExtraction: Document reading is not configured (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY required). The file is stored and you fill in the fields below yourself.
dbd.uploadFillsHint: Add more DBD documents (certificate, objectives sheet, Bor.Or.Jor.5, Bor.Or.Jor.2); every file is read and only empty fields are filled.
dbd.orEnterManually: Or enter the details manually without a file
dbd.uploadedButNotRead: The file was uploaded but could not be read ({reason}). Fill the fields yourself or try reading again.

levels.business: Level 2 — Business profile (objectives sheet / Bor.Or.Jor.5 / Bor.Or.Jor.2)
levels.interview: Level 4 — Bank interview answers (facts the DBD does not hold)
levels.answersIntro: The four answers the DBD documents can't give. They're needed before the company can be used.

dbd.objectivesHint: One objective per line; a leading number is kept, e.g. "1. To operate…"
dbd.shareholdersHint: One per line: name | nationality | shares
dbd.fileHint: PDF, up to 30 MB per file
dbd.interviewHint: Only what no document can answer. Everything else the bank asks is filled in below without anyone typing it.
dbd.amountHint: Write the amount in digits, for example 300,000. Transactions per month are worked out from the two amounts.

standardAnswers.title: Filled automatically
standardAnswers.hint: The learner is taught these answers. They come from the DBD, from the answers above, or are the same for every company.
standardAnswers.pending: Fills in once the answer it is worked out from is written

interviewFields.client_origin: Where and how customers are found

interviewFields.first_incoming_funds: Where the first money into the account comes from, and why
interviewFields.promptpay_qr_purpose: Why the company needs PromptPay / QR

interviewFields.transaction_details: How past sales were paid (method, typical amounts)

index.label: Search index
index.hint: Documents are read five pages at a time in the background (about a minute per run); reload to refresh the status.
index.removeUnavailable: The document was kept: the search index (Pinecone) is unreachable, so its vectors could not be removed first. Try again later.

ask.title: Ask the documents
ask.hint: Answers come only from the uploaded documents, with the page — use it to check what was read.
ask.placeholder: e.g. What is the registered capital? / Who holds shares?

errors.not_indexed: The documents are not indexed yet — wait until the status is "Ready"

ask.noAnswer: No model answer available; showing the passages found

dbd.deferredFill: The documents are too long to read in one pass; they are being read in the background and the fields will fill in when the index status is "Ready" (reload to see them).
dbd.readingQueued: The documents are being read in the background (about 1–3 minutes); reload the page to see the filled fields.
dbd.readingFailed: The documents could not be read ({reason}). Fill the fields yourself or click "Read the document again".
dbd.legacyHint: Written before the new evaluations and still printed on the bank-interview study card. Left blank, they follow the answers above.

coverage.allReady: Every concept has what it needs.

facts.account_purpose: Why the company needs an account

versions.title: Training versions
versions.intro: Learners study and are evaluated on a frozen copy of these facts. A save that changes them makes a new version; nobody moves to it until a person moves them.
versions.none: No version yet — it activates when nothing blocks it (see Exceptions).
versions.complete: Complete at company scope: every one of the 29 Business Knowledge Quiz and 12 Bank Readiness Interview concepts resolves.
versions.behind: {count, plural, =0 {Every learner is on this version.} one {# learner is on an older version.} other {# learners are on older versions.}}

acceptance.acceptedAuto: Accepted automatically: the reading was clean and the four details were there.
acceptance.waiting: {count, plural, one {# exception} other {# exceptions}} blocking acceptance
acceptance.blocked: Not accepted yet — settle the exceptions.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.intro: What the validators found. A record is accepted when nothing blocks acceptance; its training version activates when nothing blocks the version. Notes are for review only.
exceptions.none: Nothing open: the record is clean.

settings.title: Policy settings
settings.intro: These values drive the business rules (policy_config). Every change is audited with the owner who made it.

bank_eligibility_days.label: Days before the bank stage opens
bank_eligibility_days.help: Counted from the certificate issue date (BR-002, default 45). Changing it recomputes every learner's date.

bank_access_expiry_days.label: Days the bank stage stays open
bank_access_expiry_days.help: Counted from the opening date; blank = never expires

exam_retry_wait_hours.label: Hours to wait before retaking the Business Knowledge Quiz

exam_pass_rule.label: Business Knowledge Quiz pass rule
exam_pass_rule.help: Which result decides the passed status

require_exam_pass_for_name_card.label: Require a Business Knowledge Quiz pass for the name card
require_exam_pass_for_name_card.help: When on, learners must pass the Business Knowledge Quiz before creating a card

require_exam_pass_for_interview.label: Business Knowledge Quiz pass required before the Bank Readiness Interview
require_exam_pass_for_interview.help: When on, a learner must pass the Business Knowledge Quiz before starting the Bank Readiness Interview.

study_completion_tracking.label: Study completion rule
study_completion_tracking.help: Count a card when viewed, or only when the learner marks it completed

appointment_hours_start.label: Appointment hours start
appointment_hours_start.help: First bookable hour of the day, Bangkok time, e.g. 9

appointment_hours_end.label: Appointment hours end
appointment_hours_end.help: The hour bookings stop, Bangkok time, e.g. 16 (the last slot ends by then)

appointment_slot_minutes.label: Slot length (minutes)
appointment_slot_minutes.help: How long each slot lasts, e.g. 60

appointment_notice_hours.label: Notice (hours)
appointment_notice_hours.help: How many hours before a slot a learner may still book or cancel

appointment_holidays.label: Bank holidays
appointment_holidays.help: The Bank of Thailand's public holidays, one ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) per line, substitution days included; add next year's list each December

training_auto_accept_confidence_percent.label: Training facts: confidence read as certain (%)
training_auto_accept_confidence_percent.help: An extracted fact at or above this raises nothing. Below it, a low-confidence exception is listed for review.

training_review_confidence_percent.label: Training facts: confidence below which a person must confirm (%)
training_review_confidence_percent.help: Below this, the exception blocks acceptance of the record until a person confirms the value.

generate.title: Generate questions with AI
generate.intro: Questions are grounded in the DBD company certificate. Pick a reference certificate and a count; the model drafts multiple-choice questions in Thai, English and Chinese, using variables so each learner is asked about their own company. Everything stays a draft until you review and approve it.
generate.fakeNotice: Test mode: no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, so sample questions are generated instead.
generate.materialHint: Optional extra material for general-knowledge questions: tick study cards, paste text, or upload a file.
generate.pastedHint: Paste notes, lesson content, or your existing draft questions…
generate.fileHint: PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD (max 20 MB)
generate.templateCount: Of which ask facts from the learner's certificate
generate.templateHint: Defaults to all; the rest test understanding of the document itself.
generate.focusHint: e.g. emphasise what bank officers ask
generate.generating: Generating… (about 1–3 minutes, keep this page open)

errors.not_configured: AI is not configured (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY required). Contact an admin.

errors.invalid_output: The AI returned an invalid result. Try again.
errors.no_material: Pick a study card, paste text, or upload a file
errors.nothing_produced: No question passed validation. Try again.

generate.referenceHint: The AI reads this certificate's particulars (and its PDF when uploaded) to ask about the real facts, but never copies its values into a question — every question uses variables so each learner is asked about their own company.

home.intro: Pick a section to manage. A manager sees their own team only.
